name: useCapabilities
summary: What this particular phone actually has.
plain: The first hook to call. It answers "does this device have that?" so your interface can hide features the phone does not support, instead of showing a control that will fail.
description: Resolution starts from a model table keyed on the device name, then upgrades to real PackageManager feature checks when the native module is present, at which point verification changes from model-table to device. Fields that can only be answered by the device are null until that upgrade happens. Note two results on this Pixel that are easy to assume wrongly: it does not declare a neural processing unit feature, and it does not declare the ranging feature.

returns.name: modelName
returns.desc: Marketing model name, for example "Pixel 11 Pro".

returns.name: isPixel / isProModel / isFoldable
returns.desc: Device family flags used to gate Pro-only features.

returns.name: pixelGeneration
returns.desc: Generation number, 11 here. Null on non-Pixel hardware.

returns.name: androidApiLevel
returns.desc: API level, 37 for Android 17. Null on web.

returns.name: verification
returns.desc: Whether flags were confirmed against the device or inferred from the model name. Prefer acting on device.

returns.name: hasHiLight
returns.desc: Whether the LED array is present.

returns.name: hasUWB
returns.desc: Whether an ultra-wideband radio is present.

returns.name: hasNFC / hasBleChannelSounding / hasWifiRtt / hasSatelliteTelephony
returns.desc: Radio features confirmed from PackageManager. Null before device verification.

returns.name: hasStrongBox
returns.desc: Whether keys can be held in the dedicated secure element.

returns.name: hasNpuFeature
returns.desc: Whether a neural processing unit feature is declared. False on this device.

returns.name: geminiNanoTier
returns.desc: Which on-device model generation to expect.

returns.name: aicoreVersion
returns.desc: Installed AICore build when the native module can read it.

agentNote: Never hardcode a device assumption; read this first. Treat null as unknown rather than false, and prefer acting once verification is device.
